name: Charlie Luken
summary: Charles John Luken (born July 18, 1951), usually known publicly as Charlie Luken, is an American politician of the Democratic Party who was mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio, and served in Ohio's 1st congressional district in the United States House of Representatives. When Luken left office at the end of 2005, he was the longest-serving mayor in Cincinnati's history with 12 years and one month of service in that role.
